title: ActivityEvent
description: Unified activity event schema for FlowState. Used by all platform agents (Linux, Android, Browser, Windows) to represent a single recorded activity interval in a privacy-minimized, normalized form.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier (UUID v4). Used for duplicate-event prevention.

user_id.description: Identifier of the FlowState user who owns this event.

device_id.description: Identifier of the device or agent that recorded this event.

platform.description: The platform or agent type that produced this event.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (UTC) of when the event was recorded by the agent.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the device at the time of recording (e.g., 'America/New_York'). Preserves local-time context for insights.

app_identifier.description: Platform-specific application identifier. For Linux: process name or desktop file ID (e.g., 'code', 'firefox'). For Android: package name. Null for browser-only events.

app_name.description: Human-readable application display name. May be empty if not resolvable. Scrubbed of sensitive window title content.

window_title_summary.description: Optional privacy-scrubbed summary of the window title. Must never contain passwords, personal names from messages, or sensitive file paths. Agents should omit this field if privacy filtering cannot be guaranteed.

browser_domain.description: Registered domain of the active browser tab (e.g., 'github.com'). Never includes URL path, query parameters, or fragments. Null for non-browser events or excluded domains.

browser_tab_title_category.description: Optional coarse category inferred from the tab title by the browser extension (e.g., 'video', 'documentation', 'social'). Never the raw title.

session_start.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (UTC) when this activity session began.

session_end.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (UTC) when this activity session ended.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the activity session in seconds. Must be positive and not exceed 24 hours.

idle_seconds.description: Number of seconds the user was idle within this session. Used to distinguish active engagement from background activity.

app_switch_count.description: Number of application/tab switches observed during this session. Indicates context-switching behavior.

declared_goal_id.description: The ID of the active user-declared goal at the time of recording. Null if no goal was active.

focus_session_id.description: The ID of the active focus session at the time of recording. Null if not in a focus session.

activity_category.description: The classified activity category. Null before classification has been applied.

goal_alignment.description: Whether this activity aligns with the user's declared goal. Null if no goal was active or classification is pending.

classification_confidence.description: Confidence score of the classification, between 0.0 and 1.0. Null before classification.

classification_source.description: The mechanism that produced the activity_category.

classification_evidence.description: Short, human-readable explanations for why this classification was assigned (e.g., ['App is in productive category', 'Focus session active']).

requires_user_confirmation.description: True if confidence is below the confirmation threshold and the user should be asked to verify the category.

user_feedback.description: User correction or confirmation of the classification.

is_intentional.description: Whether the activity was intentional according to the user.

context_features.description: Derived context features used for classification. Stored for model reproducibility and debugging.

sync_status.description: Synchronization state of this event. 'excluded' means the agent's privacy filter suppressed this event from being sent.

agent_version.description: Version of the platform agent that recorded this event. Used for debugging schema compatibility.

schema_version.description: Version of the ActivityEvent schema used.
